name: Nyuuin Shimasho! ~Momoiro Kango de Shinpai Gomuyou~
original_name: 乳院しましょ！～桃色看護で心パイご無用～
source:
Breast milk disease have spread among the population. Main character adores rubbing big tits that pour milk. One day he gets invited to a clinic that specializes in milk disease treatment!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一种会让乳房分泌乳汁的疾病正在人群中蔓延。主人公最喜欢揉弄不断流出乳汁的巨乳。某天，他获邀前往一家专门治疗泌乳症的诊所！

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vndb-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
